interconnexions.name: Integration Employe -> Fiche Employe
interconnexions.type: D1 -> D2 (+ remontees qualite D2 -> D1)
interconnexions.implementation_sql: INSERT INTO admina_rh.employees (tenant_id, matricule, civilite, nom, prenom, date_naissance, lieu_naissance, genre, nationalite, situation_familiale, telephone, email, adresse, departement, poste, type_contrat, categorie, regime_travail, date_embauche, salaire_brut, lieu_travail, statut) SELECT $tenant_id, next_matricule(), i.civilite, i.nom, i.prenom, i.date_naissance, i.lieu_naissance, i.genre, i.nationalite, i.situation_familiale, i.telephone, i.email, i.adresse, i.departement, i.poste, i.type_contrat, i.categorie, i.regime_travail, i.date_embauche, i.salaire_negocie, i.lieu_travail, 'Essai' FROM admina_rh.d01_integrations i WHERE i.id = $integration_id AND i.decision_embauche = 'confirmee' RETURNING id, matricule;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Au clic 'Confirmer embauche' dans D1 (Feuille Integration Employe), appel Server Action confirmIntegrationEmployee(integrationId) qui cree la fiche employees + redirige vers /domaine2_Gestion_Administrative_Personnel/employes/[id] avec pre-remplissage des onglets Contrat, Documents, Bancaires. Un toast de confirmation affiche le nouveau matricule genere.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  D1["D1 11-Integration Employe\nd01_integrations"] -->|decision_embauche=confirmee| SA[Server Action\nconfirmIntegrationEmployee]
  SA -->|INSERT| D2["D2 2-Fiche Employe\nemployees"]
  D2 -->|webhook qualite| D1
  D2 -->|return id+matricule| UI["Frontend redirect\n/domaine2/.../employes/[id]"]
interconnexions.source_doc: Interconnexion_Bilaterale_D1_D2.pdf p.2 + V2 prompt §15.2 + §15.5 (9 documents justificatifs)

interconnexions.name: Suivi Contrats (D1) -> Contrats Travail (D2)
interconnexions.type: D1 -> D2 (+ remontees D2 -> D1 en cas d'avenant / renegociation)
interconnexions.implementation_sql: INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_contracts (tenant_id, employee_id, contract_number, type_contrat, date_debut, date_fin, salaire_brut, regime_travail, lieu_travail, statut) SELECT $tenant_id, e.id, gen_contract_number(), n.type_contrat, n.date_debut, n.date_fin, n.salaire_negocie, n.regime_travail, n.lieu_travail, 'En vigueur' FROM admina_rh.d01_contracts_negotiation n JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON e.matricule = n.matricule_candidat WHERE n.id = $negotiation_id AND n.statut_signature = 'signe' RETURNING id, contract_number;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Sur D1 - 6-Suivi Contrats, bouton 'Formaliser contrat D2' declenche la Server Action createContractFromNegotiation(negId). Le contrat est cree dans d02_contracts et un lien direct ouvre le detail dans D2 - 3-Contrats Travail. En cas de renegociation ulterieure (avenant), D2 notifie D1 via webhook pour maj sync.

d01_contracts_negotiation"] -->|signature_offre| SA[Server Action
createContractFromNegotiation]
  SA -->|INSERT| D2C["D2 3-Contrats Travail
d02_contracts"]

webhook| D1C

interconnexions.name: Periode Essai (D1) -> Avenants Contrat (D2)

source.trigger: fin periode essai avec scenario 'modification' (confirmation sans modif, rupture, ou modification des conditions initiales)

interconnexions.type: D1 -> D2 (+ remontees D2 -> D1 sur tracabilite juridique)
interconnexions.implementation_sql: INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_contract_amendments (tenant_id, contract_id, employee_id, amendment_number, type_avenant, date_effet, ancienne_valeur, nouvelle_valeur, motif, statut) SELECT $tenant_id, c.id, e.id, gen_amendment_number(c.id), t.type_modification, t.date_effet, t.ancienne_valeur, t.nouvelle_valeur, t.motif, 'valide' FROM admina_rh.d01_trial_periods t JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON e.id = t.employee_id JOIN admina_rh.d02_contracts c ON c.employee_id = e.id AND c.statut = 'En vigueur' WHERE t.id = $trial_id AND t.decision_fin_essai = 'modification' RETURNING id, amendment_number;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Sur D1 - 13-Periode Essai, au moment de clore la periode avec decision 'modification des conditions initiales', la Server Action generateAmendmentFromTrial(trialId) cree automatiquement un avenant dans D2 - 4-Avenants Contrat et redirige le gestionnaire RH vers la fiche d'avenant pre-remplie pour validation finale.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  D1T["D1 13-Periode Essai\nd01_trial_periods"] -->|decision=modification| SA[Server Action\ngenerateAmendmentFromTrial]
  SA -->|INSERT| D2A["D2 4-Avenants Contrat\nd02_contract_amendments"]
  D2A -->|webhook tracabilite| D1T

interconnexions.name: Checklist Integration (D1) <-> Suivi Documents (D2) - bidirectionnel

source.trigger: creation fiche employees + reception pieces justificatives

donnees_echangees: type_document (CNI, passeport, attestation CNPS, casier judiciaire, certificat medical, diplomes, RIB bancaire, photos, certificat domicile, contrat precedent)
interconnexions.type: D1 <-> D2 (bidirectionnel, synchrone)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
-- D1 -> D2 : a la creation d'un checklist item valide
INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_employee_documents (tenant_id, employee_id, document_number, type_document, numero_document, date_emission, date_expiration, statut, lieu_depot, notes)
SELECT $tenant_id, i.employee_id, gen_doc_number(), i.type_document, i.numero_piece, i.date_emission, i.date_expiration, 'Valide', i.lieu_depot, i.notes
FROM admina_rh.d01_integration_checklists i
WHERE i.id = $checklist_id AND i.statut_piece = 'recue'
ON CONFLICT (employee_id, type_document) DO UPDATE SET date_expiration = EXCLUDED.date_expiration, updated_at = NOW();

-- D2 -> D1 : remontee des anomalies documents manquants
INSERT INTO admina_rh.d01_checklist_alerts (tenant_id, integration_id, employee_id, type_alerte, severite)
SELECT $tenant_id, i.integration_id, e.id, 'piece_manquante', 'haute'
FROM admina_rh.employees e
JOIN admina_rh.d01_integrations i ON i.employee_id = e.id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admina_rh.d02_employee_documents d WHERE d.employee_id = e.id AND d.statut = 'Valide' AND d.type_document = 'CNI');
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Sur D1 - 12-Checklist Integration, le cochage d'une ligne 'piece recue' declenche syncTime auto vers D2 - 5-Suivi Documents. Reciproquement, dans D2 - 5-Suivi Documents, une alerte 'document expire' remonte en temps reel sur D1 - 12-Checklist Integration pour les employees recemment integres (< 3 mois) afin d'alerter le service recrutement d'un probleme de qualite en amont.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  D1CK["D1 12-Checklist Integration\nd01_integration_checklists"] <-->|pieces justificatives| D2D["D2 5-Suivi Documents\nd02_employee_documents"]
  D2D -->|anomalie piece manquante| D1CK
interconnexions.source_doc: Interconnexion_Bilaterale_D1_D2.pdf p.3-4 + V2 prompt §15.2 + §15.5 (9 documents justificatifs)

interconnexions.name: Suivi Post-Embauche (D1) -> Tableau de Bord (D2)

source.trigger: aggregation mensuelle des indicateurs qualite onboarding

interconnexions.type: D1 -> D2 (+ boucle de retroaction D2 -> D1 pour amelioration continue)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_kpi_snapshot (tenant_id, periode, kpi_code, valeur, categorie, source_domain)
SELECT $tenant_id, $periode_mois, kpi_code, valeur, 'qualite_onboarding', 'D1'
FROM (VALUES
  ('taux_retention_3_mois', (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date_embauche >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 months' AND statut='Actif') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date_embauche >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 months'),0) FROM admina_rh.employees)),
  ('taux_retention_6_mois', (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date_embauche >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' AND statut='Actif') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date_embauche >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'),0) FROM admina_rh.employees)),
  ('turnover_precoce_essai', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admina_rh.employees WHERE statut='Inactif' AND date_embauche >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'))
) AS t(kpi_code, valeur)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, periode, kpi_code) DO UPDATE SET valeur = EXCLUDED.valeur, updated_at = NOW();
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Sur D2 - 1-Tableau de Bord, nouvelle carte 'Qualite Onboarding D1' qui affiche les 5 KPIs de suivi post-embauche. Sur D1 - 17-Suivi Post-Embauche, un panneau 'Remontees qualite D2' affiche les anomalies detectees par le service administratif (documents manquants, erreurs saisie, incoherences contractuelles) pour ajuster le processus de recrutement en amont.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  D1P["D1 17-Suivi Post-Embauche
d01_post_hiring_followup"] -->|KPIs qualite mensuels| D2TB["D2 1-Tableau de Bord
d02_kpi_snapshot"]
  D2TB -->|anomalies / Retex
boucle retroaction| D1P

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Contrats Travail (VLOOKUP Matricule -> Nom)
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN + COALESCE remplace IFERROR(VLOOKUP))
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT c.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.departement, e.poste, e.date_embauche
FROM admina_rh.d02_contracts c
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON c.employee_id = e.id AND c.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE c.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY c.date_debut DESC;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 3-Contrats Travail, la colonne 'Employe' est alimentee automatiquement par le composant EmployeePicker (recherche par matricule/nom) qui declenche un JOIN server-side. Le nom n'est jamais saisi manuellement (integrite referentielle employee_id FK).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master 2-Fiche Employe
employees (matricule PK)"] -.FK employee_id.-> S1["Satellite 3-Contrats Travail
d02_contracts
cardinalite 1:N"]
interconnexions.source_doc: V2 prompt §9.2 (formule type Excel) + §9.3 matrice ligne 1

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Avenants Contrat
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT a.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.poste
FROM admina_rh.d02_contract_amendments a
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE a.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY a.date_effet DESC;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 4-Avenants Contrat, la colonne Employe est remplie via JOIN (jamais de saisie manuelle). A la selection d'un employee, le contrat actif en vigueur est auto-rempli.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S2["Satellite 4-Avenants Contrat\nd02_contract_amendments\n1:N"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Suivi Documents
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT d.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.departement,
       CASE WHEN d.date_expiration IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN d.date_expiration < NOW() THEN 'Expire'
            WHEN d.date_expiration <= NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'A renouveler'
            ELSE 'Valide' END AS statut_calcule
FROM admina_rh.d02_employee_documents d
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON d.employee_id = e.id AND d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE d.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY d.date_expiration NULLS LAST;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 5-Suivi Documents, la colonne Employe provient du JOIN. Le statut (Valide/A renouveler/Expire) est calcule dynamiquement par trigger SQL avant INSERT/UPDATE (cf. IC-D2-02).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S3["Satellite 5-Suivi Documents\nd02_employee_documents\n1:N"]
interconnexions.source_doc: V2 prompt §9.3 matrice ligne 3 + §13.9 (bascule statut auto)

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Donnees Bancaires
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN + contrainte UNIQUE sur employee_id pour RIB principal)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT b.*, e.nom, e.prenom
FROM admina_rh.d02_bank_details b
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON b.employee_id = e.id AND b.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE b.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY b.statut = 'Actif' DESC, b.created_at DESC;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 6-Donnees Bancaires, la liste RIB par employe est alimentee par JOIN. Au maximum 1 RIB actif par employe (contrainte applicative).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S4["Satellite 6-Donnees Bancaires\nd02_bank_details\n1:1 ou 1:N"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Mutuelle Prevoyance
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN, 1:1 strict)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT m.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.situation_familiale
FROM admina_rh.d02_mutual_insurance m
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON m.employee_id = e.id AND m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE m.tenant_id = $tenant_id AND m.statut_adhesion = 'Active';
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 7-Mutuelle Prevoyance, le nom employe est auto-rempli via JOIN. Si situation_familiale='Marie(e)' ou couverture='Familiale', le formulaire propose l'ajout des ayants droit.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S5["Satellite 7-Mutuelle Prevoyance\nd02_mutual_insurance\n1:1"]

interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT lr.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.departement, e.categorie
FROM admina_rh.d02_leave_requests lr
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON lr.employee_id = e.id AND lr.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE lr.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY lr.date_debut DESC;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 8-Conges Annuels, le nom employe provient du JOIN. Le dropdown d'EmployeePicker est filtre par tenant et n'affiche que les employes actifs.

interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:

FROM admina_rh.d02_absences ab
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON ab.employee_id = e.id AND ab.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE ab.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY ab.date_debut DESC;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 10-Absences Maladie, le nom employe provient du JOIN. A la validation d'une absence > 3 jours, declenchement auto d'une visite medicale de reprise (cf. IC-D2-08).

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Heures Supplementaires
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT ot.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.salaire_brut,
       ROUND((e.salaire_brut / 173.33) * ot.heures_supp * (1 + ot.taux_majoration/100.0), 2) AS montant_calcule_auto
FROM admina_rh.d02_overtime_hours ot
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON ot.employee_id = e.id AND ot.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE ot.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY ot.semaine DESC, e.nom;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 11-Heures Supplementaires, le nom + salaire brut est auto-rempli depuis employees. Le salaire_horaire_base et le montant_calcule sont calcules automatiquement (cf. RC-007 et RC-008).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S8["Satellite 11-Heures Supp\nd02_overtime_hours\n1:N"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Pointage Presence
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT ar.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.departement, e.poste
FROM admina_rh.d02_attendance_records ar
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON ar.employee_id = e.id AND ar.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE ar.tenant_id = $tenant_id AND ar.semaine = $semaine
ORDER BY e.nom, e.prenom;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 12-Pointage Presence, le nom + departement est auto-rempli. La saisie quotidienne (badgeage) alimente l'agregation hebdomadaire, qui alimente ensuite le planning mensuel (cf. IC-D2-04).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S9["Satellite 12-Pointage Presence\nd02_attendance_records\n1:N quotidien/hebdo"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Fiches de Paie
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN + JOIN secondaire vers d02_bank_details)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT ps.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.salaire_brut, e.departement, b.banque, b.numero_compte
FROM admina_rh.d02_pay_slips ps
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON ps.employee_id = e.id AND ps.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.d02_bank_details b ON b.employee_id = e.id AND b.statut = 'Actif'
WHERE ps.tenant_id = $tenant_id AND ps.mois = $mois
ORDER BY e.nom;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 14-Fiches de Paie, le salaire brut + RIB actif est auto-rempli. La generation de fiche declenche un calcul automatique (salaire_brut + HS validees + primes - retenues - cotisations - deductions_prets) cf. RC-012.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S10["Satellite 14-Fiches de Paie
d02_pay_slips
1:N mensuel"]
  S10 -.JOIN secondaire.-> B["d02_bank_details
(RIB actif)"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Autorisations Permis
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT wp.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.nationalite,
       CASE WHEN wp.date_expiration IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN wp.date_expiration < NOW() THEN 'Expire'
            WHEN wp.date_expiration <= NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 'A renouveler'
            ELSE 'Valide' END AS statut_calcule
FROM admina_rh.d02_work_permits wp
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON wp.employee_id = e.id AND wp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE wp.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY wp.date_expiration NULLS LAST;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 15-Autorisations Permis, le nom + nationalite est auto-rempli. Pour les employes etrangers (nationalite != pays du tenant), un rappel auto est genere si permis expire < 30j (cf. IC-D2-03).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S11["Satellite 15-Autorisations Permis\nd02_work_permits\n1:N"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Dossiers Departs
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN, 1:1 strict, impact sur employees.statut)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT dp.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.date_embauche, e.salaire_brut, e.type_contrat
FROM admina_rh.d02_departures dp
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON dp.employee_id = e.id AND dp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE dp.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY dp.date_depart DESC;

-- Bascule automatique du statut employee a 'Inactif' a la cloture du dossier
UPDATE admina_rh.employees SET statut='Inactif', updated_at=NOW()
WHERE id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM admina_rh.d02_departures WHERE statut_dossier='clos' AND tenant_id=$tenant_id);
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 16-Dossiers Departs, le nom + date embauche + salaire est auto-rempli. La cloture du dossier (statut_dossier='clos') declenche IC-D2-09 (auto-create Archive) + bascule employees.statut='Inactif'.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S12["Satellite 16-Dossiers Departs\nd02_departures\n1:1 final"]
  S12 -->|cloture dossier| UPDATE["employees.statut = Inactif"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Archivage Documents
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN + conservation donnees historiques post-depart)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT arc.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.matricule
FROM admina_rh.d02_document_archives arc
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON arc.employee_id = e.id AND arc.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE arc.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY arc.date_archivage DESC;

-- NB : ne pas supprimer employees a l'archivage, marquer statut='Archive'
-- pour preserver l'integrite referentielle des archives
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 17-Archivage, le nom + matricule est conserve. Une regle d'acces strict (RBAC) limite la lecture aux roles 'Archiviste' et 'DRH'. La duree de conservation est affichee (5 ans / 50 ans selon nature document).
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees
(statut='Archive' conserve)"] -.FK employee_id.-> S13["Satellite 17-Archivage
d02_document_archives
1:N"]

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Rappels Admin
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN) + generation automatique (cf. IC-D2-02/03/06)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
SELECT r.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.departement,
       CASE WHEN r.date_echeance < NOW() AND r.statut='en_attente' THEN 'en_retard'
            ELSE r.statut END AS statut_calcule
FROM admina_rh.d02_reminders r
LEFT JOIN admina_rh.employees e ON r.employee_id = e.id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
WHERE r.tenant_id = $tenant_id
ORDER BY r.date_echeance ASC;
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 18-Rappels Admin, le nom employe est auto-rempli. Un cron quotidien (00:30) detecte les rappels en retard (date_echeance < NOW()) et bascule statut='en_retard'. Cf. trigger 17.6 #6 du V2 prompt.
interconnexions.diagram:
flowchart LR
  M["Master employees"] -.FK employee_id.-> S14["Satellite 18-Rappels Admin
d02_reminders
1:N"]
  CRON["Cron quotidien
00:30"] -->|UPDATE statut=en_retard| S14
interconnexions.source_doc: V2 prompt §9.3 matrice ligne 14 + §13.10 (generation auto rappels) + §17.6 trigger #6

interconnexions.name: Fiche Employe -> Prets Avances
interconnexions.type: Master-Satellite (LEFT JOIN)

SELECT l.*, e.nom, e.prenom, e.salaire_brut,

interconnexions.implementation_sql:
-- Trigger V2 prompt §17.6 #5
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admina_rh.update_leave_balance() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE admina_rh.d02_leave_balances
  SET conges_pris_jours = (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(nombre_jours),0)
        FROM admina_rh.d02_leave_requests
        WHERE employee_id = NEW.employee_id
          AND type_conge = 'conge_annuel'
          AND statut = 'approuvee'
          AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_debut) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NEW.date_debut)
      ),
      solde_disponible = droit_annuel_jours + report_n1_jours
        - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(nombre_jours),0) FROM admina_rh.d02_leave_requests WHERE employee_id=NEW.employee_id AND type_conge='conge_annuel' AND statut='approuvee' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_debut)=EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NEW.date_debut))
        - conges_en_cours,
      taux_utilisation = ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(nombre_jours),0) FROM admina_rh.d02_leave_requests WHERE employee_id=NEW.employee_id AND type_conge='conge_annuel' AND statut='approuvee' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_debut)=EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NEW.date_debut)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(droit_annuel_jours,0), 2),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE employee_id = NEW.employee_id AND annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NEW.date_debut);
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_leave_request_approved
  AFTER UPDATE OF statut ON admina_rh.d02_leave_requests
  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.statut = 'approuvee')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION admina_rh.update_leave_balance();

interconnexions.implementation_sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admina_rh.generate_pay_slips_on_planning_close() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.statut = 'cloture' THEN
    INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_pay_slips (tenant_id, employee_id, mois, salaire_base, salaire_brut, cotisations, net_a_payer, mode_paiement, statut)
    SELECT
      NEW.tenant_id, NEW.employee_id, NEW.mois,
      e.salaire_brut AS salaire_base,
      e.salaire_brut
        + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(montant_calcule) FROM admina_rh.d02_overtime_hours ot WHERE ot.employee_id=e.id AND ot.statut='validee' AND ot.semaine LIKE NEW.mois||'%'),0)
        - ROUND((e.salaire_brut / NULLIF(NEW.jours_ouvrables,0)) * NEW.jours_absents, 2) AS salaire_brut,
      ROUND((e.salaire_brut
        + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(montant_calcule) FROM admina_rh.d02_overtime_hours ot WHERE ot.employee_id=e.id AND ot.statut='validee' AND ot.semaine LIKE NEW.mois||'%'),0)
        - ROUND((e.salaire_brut / NULLIF(NEW.jours_ouvrables,0)) * NEW.jours_absents, 2)) * 0.1625, 2) AS cotisations,
      (e.salaire_brut
        + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(montant_calcule) FROM admina_rh.d02_overtime_hours ot WHERE ot.employee_id=e.id AND ot.statut='validee' AND ot.semaine LIKE NEW.mois||'%'),0)
        - ROUND((e.salaire_brut / NULLIF(NEW.jours_ouvrables,0)) * NEW.jours_absents, 2))
      - ROUND((e.salaire_brut
        + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(montant_calcule) FROM admina_rh.d02_overtime_hours ot WHERE ot.employee_id=e.id AND ot.statut='validee' AND ot.semaine LIKE NEW.mois||'%'),0)
        - ROUND((e.salaire_brut / NULLIF(NEW.jours_ouvrables,0)) * NEW.jours_absents, 2)) * 0.1625, 2)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.mensualite) FROM admina_rh.d02_loans p WHERE p.employee_id=e.id AND p.statut='en_remboursement'),0) AS net_a_payer,
      COALESCE((SELECT mode_paiement FROM admina_rh.d02_bank_details b WHERE b.employee_id=e.id AND b.statut='Actif' LIMIT 1), 'Virement') AS mode_paiement,
      'generee' AS statut
    FROM admina_rh.employees e
    WHERE e.id = NEW.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_planning_close_generate_payslips
  AFTER UPDATE OF statut ON admina_rh.d02_monthly_planning
  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.statut = 'cloture')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION admina_rh.generate_pay_slips_on_planning_close();

interconnexions.name: Pret accorde -> Deduction automatique en Paie
interconnexions.type: D2 interne (lecture a la generation de paie + incrementation mois_payes apres paiement)
interconnexions.implementation_sql:
-- La mensualite de pret est deduite automatiquement du net_a_payer (cf. IC-D2-05 formule net_a_payer)

-- Trigger : apres paiement de la fiche de paie, incrementer mois_payes et maj solde_restant
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admina_rh.update_loan_after_payment() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.statut = 'payee' AND (OLD.statut IS NULL OR OLD.statut != 'payee') THEN
    UPDATE admina_rh.d02_loans
    SET mois_payes = COALESCE(mois_payes, 0) + 1,
        solde_restant = GREATEST(0, montant_accorde - (mensualite * (COALESCE(mois_payes, 0) + 1))),
        statut = CASE WHEN COALESCE(mois_payes, 0) + 1 >= duree_mois THEN 'solde' ELSE 'en_remboursement' END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE employee_id = NEW.employee_id
      AND tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
      AND statut IN ('accorde', 'en_remboursement')
      AND date_debut_remboursement <= NOW();
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_payslip_paid_update_loans
  AFTER UPDATE OF statut ON admina_rh.d02_pay_slips
  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.statut = 'payee')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION admina_rh.update_loan_after_payment();
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 19-Prets Avances, au passage en statut 'accorde', la mensualite est figee et un message confirme 'Ce pret sera deduit automatiquement de la paie mensuelle pendant X mois'. Apres chaque paiement de paie, le solde restant est decremente et affiche dans le tableau. Le pret passe en statut 'solde' quand mois_payes >= duree_mois.

interconnexions.implementation_sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admina_rh.archive_employee_on_departure_close() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.statut_dossier = 'clos' AND (OLD.statut_dossier IS NULL OR OLD.statut_dossier != 'clos') THEN
    -- 1. Transfert de tous les documents actifs vers l'archivage
    INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_document_archives (tenant_id, employee_id, archive_number, type_document, numero_document, date_archivage, duree_conservation_ans, lieu_depot, source_table)
    SELECT NEW.tenant_id, d.employee_id, 'ARC-' || NEW.id || '-' || d.id, d.type_document, d.numero_document, NOW(),
      CASE d.type_document
        WHEN 'CNI' THEN 10 WHEN 'Passeport' THEN 10 WHEN 'RIB bancaire' THEN 10
        WHEN 'Contrat precedent' THEN 50 WHEN 'Attestation CNPS' THEN 50
        ELSE 5 END,
      'Archive numerique', 'd02_employee_documents'
    FROM admina_rh.d02_employee_documents d WHERE d.employee_id = NEW.employee_id AND d.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id;

    -- 2. Transfert des contrats vers archivage
    INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_document_archives (tenant_id, employee_id, archive_number, type_document, numero_document, date_archivage, duree_conservation_ans, lieu_depot, source_table)
    SELECT NEW.tenant_id, c.employee_id, 'ARC-' || NEW.id || '-CTR-' || c.id, 'Contrat', c.contract_number, NOW(), 50, 'Coffre fort', 'd02_contracts'
    FROM admina_rh.d02_contracts c WHERE c.employee_id = NEW.employee_id AND c.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id;

    -- 3. Bascule du statut employee -> 'Inactif' (conservation de la fiche pour integrite referentielle)
    UPDATE admina_rh.employees
    SET statut = 'Inactif', updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = NEW.employee_id AND tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id;

    -- 4. Generation d'un rappel de destruction a la fin de la duree de conservation
    INSERT INTO admina_rh.d02_reminders (tenant_id, employee_id, type_rappel, description, date_echeance, statut, action_requise)
    SELECT NEW.tenant_id, NEW.employee_id, 'destruction_archive',
           'Destruction archives employee ' || NEW.employee_id,
           NOW() + INTERVAL '50 years',
           'en_attente',
           'Verifier duree conservation puis detruire archives'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admina_rh.d02_reminders r WHERE r.employee_id = NEW.employee_id AND r.type_rappel = 'destruction_archive');
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_departure_close_archive
  AFTER UPDATE OF statut_dossier ON admina_rh.d02_departures
  FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.statut_dossier = 'clos')
  EXECUTE FUNCTION admina_rh.archive_employee_on_departure_close();
interconnexions.implementation_frontend: Dans D2 - 16-Dossiers Departs, au clic 'Cloturer dossier' (apres checklist complete : solde tout compte, attestation, certificat, restitution materiel), le trigger SQL declenche 4 actions atomiques : (1) transfert de tous les documents vers 17-Archivage, (2) bascule employees.statut='Inactif', (3) generation d'un rappel 'destruction_archive' a +50 ans, (4) notification au service RH. La fiche employee reste consultable (en lecture seule) pour preserver l'integrite referentielle.

  TRG -->|UPDATE| EMP["employees.statut=Inactif\n(fiche conservee)"]
  TRG -->|INSERT +50 ans| RAP["18-Rappels\ntype=destruction_archive"]
